# CollisionFilterExtension

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Hide overlapping objects (e.g., labels).
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/collision-filter-extension",
  "type": "CollisionFilterExtensionOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/collision-filter-extension').par.collisionEnabled` (an input) and `op('/collision-filter-extension').out.extension` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.collisionEnabled`, `out.extension`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `collisionEnabled` | `BooleanField` | `true` |
| `collisionGroup` | `StringField` | `"default"` |
| `getCollisionPriority` | `NumberField` | `0` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Name | Type |
|------|------|
| `extension` | `ExtensionField` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->
